front.title: Protocol Conformance Test Evidence Records: A Reproducibility Profile

abstract.t: This document proposes a narrow record profile for describing software protocol-conformance test runs, including the tested artifact, test suite, implementation, execution environment, individual case outcomes, digests, and known limitations. It does not define a new signature scheme, attestation architecture, transparency service, or general-purpose test-output language. Implementations are encouraged to reuse existing mechanisms such as SCITT statements, RATS terminology, COSE, JSON canonicalization, and existing test-report formats where suitable. This individual draft candidate has not been submitted to or endorsed by the IETF.
